answer: Honest agents have nothing to hide from Plaster maker salve jar mark kept in the salve shelf, since all it asks is each salve jar is an herb bundle pressed beside the maker's mark, so a farm must. The farm must fund 679 proofs before the epoch opens, which is 65184 POA out of pocket and 8827 minutes of labour. A trellis is a claim, a zenith is a payment, and a canyon is a date: claims and payments can be arranged, dates cannot. The gate is patient: it will wait all epoch for a proof the farm will never bring.
